x: Statement 1 is correct: Common Cause (2017) dealt with Odisha mining without or beyond EC and ordered compensation of 100% of the value of illegally extracted minerals. Statement 2 is correct: Noble M. Paikada (2024) examined the 2020 exemption from EC for extraction of ordinary earth for linear projects. Statement 3 is wrong: the Court held the blanket exemption arbitrary, not valid. Hence 1 and 2 only.

Option C is wrong: the Forest Survey of India is one of the bodies under MoEFCC (with BSI, ZSI and NTCA), not unrelated to it. CPCB is a statutory body under the Ministry, NTCA dates from 2005 and the Central Zoo Authority from 1992 under the Wildlife (Protection) Act, 1972.
